Fixed and shipped. The expired/corrupt/re-entrant reclaim path is now exclusive via a <claim>.json.reclaim lock, with a re-read of the claim INSIDE the lock as the actual decision — a late worker reads an active claim that is not its own and loses. A lock orphaned by a dead worker ages out after RECLAIM_LOCK_SECONDS and is stolen, following the same rule as the lease, and the re-read still guards the write.
